note: Family-run RV park on the west side of Mitchell, a quarter mile off I-90 exit 330 and about 2 miles west of Cabela's; handy for the Corn Palace. Shady sites, an outdoor pool, game room, playground and two rental cabins. --Claude
summary: Operator site read (2026): open year-round, 54 RV sites (map), rates $25 electric-only to $50 premium pull-thru (+tax), weekly/monthly available, Good Sam + military discounts stated, 2027 bookings open Jan 1 on Campspot. Fees low 35 -> 25 (electric-only tier). Google 4.6/441. Price gate passes.
flags: PRICE GATE: passes - cheapest electric RV night $25 (20/30 A or 30/50 A electric-only back-in), highest $50 (premium pull-thru). No gateway needed. Google 4.6/441.

LONG-STAY: 'Weekly/Monthly Rates also available'; the 2026 map shows 54 RV sites plus two 'Private Apartments' buildings; occupancy can't be counted under the canopy and Campspot was not opened. The site's headline is nightly (posted nightly table, interstate directions, year-round reservations); nothing discourages nightly guests, no standing minimum, no age rule.
